values.formattedValue: UbD Units provide teachers with insight on instructional expectations for the week. This resource provides guidance for discussion during professional learning communities (PLCs). PLCs foster collaboration, data-driven decision making, and sharpen the skills of novice and seasoned teachers. Clarifications, questions, and robust discussions occur within PLCs. Conversations around necessary connections between desired results, assessments, and learning experiences must take place within the PLC. The way in which specific subjects and grade levels are utilizing resources effectively and with fidelity should be discussed within the PLC.
